title: A Dinner Party
passage: Hey, everyone, do you have any plans this weekend? If you're interested, I was thinking about having a potluck. Hey, Joe, that sounds like a good idea. Yes, that sounds really nice. So, what's on the menu? I will make dessert because I have a sweet tooth. I can make a chocolate cake and cookies. I'm good at making food too, so I will make hamburgers and hot dogs. Perhaps I will make some snacks. I can make cheese balls and salad bowls. I'm getting hungry already. Where will we have this potluck? Well, my family is going out this weekend, so we could have it at my place. My house has a really big backyard, so we could sit outside and enjoy the nice weather while we eat. I'll set the date on my calendar. I'm looking forward to seeing you all soon.
